title: NestedVLA: Learning to Consolidate and Generate Skills for Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.23271v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models promise generalist robotic agents, yet consolidating skills learned across heterogeneous tasks and environments remains difficult: training data is fragmented across platforms, joint multi-task training suffers from interference, and model merging tends to introduce parameter conflicts or require architectural changes. We instead advocate a paradigm in which skills are first learned independently and then consolidated post hoc. To this end, we propose NestedVLA, which replaces parameter aggregation with parameter generation: a nested hypernetwork, conditioned on the target task, synthesizes task-adaptive action-expert parameters that compose with a frozen base VLA. Task-specific compressed VLM residuals are retained separately. This formulation enables flexible task-conditioned skill reuse while mitigating interference. translated_title: NestedVLA：学习整合与生成视觉-语言-动作模型的技能
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型有望实现通用机器人智能体，然而跨异构任务与环境整合所学习的技能仍然十分困难：训练数据分散在不同平台上，联合多任务训练存在相互干扰的问题，而模型合并往往引入参数冲突或需要改变模型架构。为此，我们倡导一种先独立学习技能、再进行事后整合的范式。具体而言，我们提出NestedVLA，用参数生成取代参数聚合：一个嵌套超网络以目标任务为条件，合成任务自适应的动作专家参数，并与冻结的基础VLA模型组合；任务特定的压缩VLM残差则被单独保留。这一设计实现了灵活的任务条件化技能复用，同时缓解了任务间的干扰。在三个强化学习基准（MetaWorld、ManiSkill、CALVIN）上，NestedVLA的表现超越了现有方法。
tldr: NestedVLA提出用嵌套超网络生成任务自适应的动作专家参数来事后整合独立学习的技能，从而在多个机器人操作基准上实现灵活的任务条件化技能复用并有效缓解任务间干扰。
